title: Position cutting die and cut leather
setting: Footwear factory, standing at a clicker press
masks_caveat: the leather strip is not outlined; the die's outline is lost under the press head during the cut. The press handle (the red ball on the lever) is outlined only where it was found reliably: 0–0.3 s and 7.0–8.9 s.
contact_roles: the right hand sets the die on the leather strip; the left hand swings the press and pulls its handle. The press head is not one of the outlined objects, so a hand swinging or pushing it reads as free. Parts of this clip's contact were corrected by a reviewer watching the video, where the automatic cues missed it (those frames are marked as reviewer-corrected in the data).
